title: Real-Time Voice AI Hears but Does Not Listen

bias_targets.methodology: Presenting realtime voice models with conflicting lexical (transcript) and non-lexical (vocal delivery, accent, age) cues to measure their over-reliance on the text semantics rather than the acoustic properties of the voice.

Evaluating model decisions in consequential multi-turn scenarios (e.g., 911 callbacks, wire-fraud checks, volunteer recruitment) where the speaker's emotional tone (crying, frightened, sarcastic) explicitly contradicts their reassuring or compliant words.

Prompting models to identify a speaker's regional accent (e.g., Indian, Australian, Nigerian, French, Mandarin) when they read scripts describing different countries (e.g., Italy, Japan, Netherlands) to test if the model assumes the accent matches the text.

Asking models to estimate the speaker's age from audio clips where older adult voices read monologues containing child-coded language to see if models ignore mature vocal acoustics in favor of the script.
